rules: A bore LARGER than 108.1 fits (it seats on the tapered nuts); a bore SMALLER cannot fit and no ring corrects it.
Published bores run 108.2 (Enkei) to 110.5 (Hayashi, BRADLEY, older Weds - lug-centric). Store bore per brand, not as a constant.

PCD 139.7 puts the nut centres at r = 69.9 mm, so a typical 108-110 mm cap cannot reach them: exposed nuts are the default. Only five wheels here cover them (DEAN Cross Country / California / Colorado, SHOWA GARAGE R8, 5ZIGEN TF500 XC-M); APIO Ventura and SR+ need two face states.
Offset at -5 or deeper protrudes past the fender and needs over-fenders; +20/+22 is the kei JB64 fitment and tucks inside the arch.
16x6.5J and 16x7J barely exist in 5x139.7; genuine 15x5.5J is rarer still (most 15in options are 6.0J).

TAIWAN — how to read a price here. Almost every Taiwanese Jimny wheel listing is PER WHEEL (單顆價), and the shops that mean a set say so in words. Three exceptions found, and all three are traps: 花蓮太陽輪胎's 15×8.0J −19 is NT$16,000 四顆合售 (per set); LikeShop's 15×7.0J −10 shows NT$5,000 in search results which is a DEPOSIT against a NT$18,800 set; and i-PICKUP's 類OZ NT$6,800 is EX-TAX (未稅), so the real figure is ~NT$7,140. A fourth, URNIETA UR007 at NT$9,400, is sold by MRK with a 單顆 option and by 希琦 as a set of four — the two distributors contradict each other and this is unresolved.

TAIWAN — bore is the thing nobody publishes, and it is the one number that cannot be corrected later. Of everything buyable here, only MRK's own retro range (108.1), EP61143 (108.1), AI-DESIGN-D ID7 (108.1), 超鑫 A-3718 / 耀麒 H598 (108.2) and MAHOM MFF-37x (110.2) publish a figure. 小茵輪胎舘 and i-PICKUP print '中心孔108', which is a rounded label rather than a measurement — 108.0 would not go on. Every Japanese wheel sold here (DEAN, SHOWA GARAGE, NITRO POWER, JAOS, EvoCorse) is sold with NO bore stated on the Taiwanese page at all.

TAIWAN — the market splits cleanly in three. (1) NT$3,300–5,500 per wheel: Taiwanese flow-formed castings, ARTC tested, sold by tyre shops on Ruten and Yahoo 拍賣 — MAXX, 耀麒 H598, MAHOM, EP61143, 小茵, 代號90. (2) NT$7,450–10,500 per wheel: Japanese brands with a real Taiwanese distributor — 希琦企業 (SHOWA GARAGE R8 / GUNFIELD / SR432 / IGNITION EIGHT, DEAN Cross Country) and MRK 4X4 (DEAN Cross Country / COLORADO, NITRO POWER H12, URNIETA), plus JAOS via MyRack. (3) Everything else in this atlas — APIO, MLJ XTREME-J, Weds MUD VANCE, BRADLEY, RS Watanabe, WORK, Enkei, most of RAYS — has NO Taiwanese stock and NO published NT$ price. 傑誠國際 JP Racing (新北) will special-order them and quotes by Line only.

TAIWAN — the default is MAXX 16×6.0J ±0, NT$4,000–4,400 per wheel (NT$17,600 a set). It appears at 超前輪業, 超鑫國際, 四個圈輪業, 真便宜輪胎館, Ruten, Yahoo 拍賣 and BigGo; 7.15 kg, flow-formed, made in Taiwan. If a Taiwanese shop puts an aftermarket wheel on a JB74 without the owner asking for anything specific, this is it. The cheapest credible option is EP61143 16×6.5J ±0 at NT$3,400 ex-tax from 超前輪業 — published 108.1 bore, but 8 kg and a 15–21 day lead.

TAIWAN — Taiwan-made lookalikes of the Japanese faces exist and are HONEST about it. 超前輪業 and 超鑫國際 title their listings 類RAYS and 類RAYS TE37X CK; i-PICKUP titles its 16×5.5J −20 類OZ; a Shopee seller lists a 類WORK. 類 means 'resembling', it is printed in the product title rather than buried, and no Taiwanese seller found in this sweep claimed a copy was genuine. The one place a brand name IS asserted is 超前輪業's NT$14,000 「日本正品 RAYS 鍛造鋁圈」, which is a parallel-import single wheel and does not name a model at all.

TAIWAN — the 15-inch market here is a different shape from Japan's. Japan sells 15×6.0J; Taiwan has standardised on 15×7.0J ±0 (耀麒 H598, 超鑫 A-3718/A-634, 代號90 EL, 花蓮太陽輪胎), a width that barely exists in the Japanese catalogues, plus 15×7.0J at −10 and −25 and a 15×8.0J at −19. Military green and cream white are stock colours here and are almost absent from the Japanese ranges.

wheels.finishes: Gloss Black / smoke-clear rim band · Semi-gloss Black / wood-copper rim band
wheels.cap: None. OEM cap will not fit; rear-only APIO hub cap optional. Nuts exposed, bore open.
wheels.modelling: Dished face. 16 equal round holes in one ring — the renkon (lotus-root) pattern — each sunk in a countersunk conical well pressed toward the rim, so every hole carries a rolled lip and a hard internal shadow. Raised slightly convex hub plateau holds 5 shallow round lug wells with machined flat seats; nuts exposed and bright against black. 5 small embossed rectangular tabs (JWL/VIA/load ratings) between the lug wells. Open bore ringed by a machined bright chamfer. Smooth stepped lip carrying a contrast-coloured rim band — model as a separate material, it is the signature. No rivets, no beadlock ring, no brand name on the face.

wheels.finishes: Sputtered Chrome — the only finish
wheels.cap: Dedicated cap included, and uniquely usable on the front wheels too. Small polished dome at 14–18% of face — covers the bore only, nuts exposed.
wheels.modelling: A hot-rod slot-mag, and the most expensive APIO by a wide margin. Deep dish: a broad unbroken mirror-chrome dish wall sweeps inboard from the rim flange to the disc and dominates the read. 5 broad tapered spokes radiate from a raised centre star to the dish wall — smooth convex blades with a soft central crown, everything rounded and highly reflective, no sharp creases. 5 long curved slot windows cut between the spokes where the disc meets the dish wall, each a wide crescent with rounded ends and a thick rolled lip — the classic slot-mag keyhole. Hub is a raised 5-point star boss with the lug positions as deep round wells sunk into the star arms. 5 decorative raised pin heads on the star boss, one between each pair of lug wells. Cap seated in an engraved knurled collar ring.

The optional cap is flat and almost flush by design — if you model it, keep it paper-thin. Ornament is stripped out: no pin bolts, no fake beadlock. The most austere XTREME-J.

wheels.finishes: Satin Black · Gloss Machined · Matte Bronze / Black Rim
wheels.cap: Capless in 5×139.7; Jimny/Sierra-specific low-profile rear cap optional. Nuts exposed.
wheels.modelling: The most detailed face in the MLJ range, released 2025-09. Exactly 16 fin spokes drawing a concave toward the centre. Model that second layer or it will not read as XJ08. The rim flange is covered in square through-holes — genuinely pierced, not dimples, functioning as grit and water ejectors. Chrome steel flange bolts run around the outer edge for a real beadlock impression.

Lip is plain and smooth; the outer flange is 11.3 mm wide on the Jimny sizes specifically (17/18-inch use 13.3 mm) and Enkei state there is no protrusion past the rim end face.
